June 15 34.

Dear Mr. Sarly,

I forward herewith for your information
tabulated statement relating to the arrest by
the Municipal Police of a communist named Hauh
Kyi(霍機) at 7.30 a.m. June 7, 1934, in the
Dah Yoong(大榮) Rubber Factory, 1 Chining Road.
The accused appeared on remand before the
Second Branch of the Kiangsu High Court on June 13
and was ordered to be handed over to the Chinese
Authorities.

Yours sincerely,

Monsieur R. Sarly,
French Police Headquarters.

Date / /

Sheet No. 3.

Proceedings
Mr. Wong: During the remand police found no further
evidence preferred against the accused.
Laung Pau, Rep. of P.S.B.:— Acting on information received
from Loo-wing & Shanghai Garrison Commander in an official letter
(produced) that one named Kau Ching Laung was a communist, on the
5th inst, this man surrendered himself to us, and implicated this
accused and two others as being members of communist party. On the
last hearing, when the accused was questioned in the open Court, he
admitted that he has joined the Labourer Union of Loo Tung Che
(Eastern Shanghai Division) under the control of Chinese settlement.
I ask the Court to hand this accused over to the Public Safety
Bureau for trial.
Accused:— I am not a communist. The man Kau Ching Laung,
who has grudge against me made false implication.
Mr. Wong:— This case was remanded to enable P.S.B. to produce
further evidence and a despatch, but recently, the P.S.B
can produce no conclusive evidence besides the despatch (produced).
Further, accused was arrested in the Settlement and under the juris-
diction of this Court, so I oppose that the accused be handed over
to P.S.B. for trial.
Decision:— Accused allowed to be handed over to P.S.B.
for trial.

1/2
D.C. Kueh.

诉讼程序
黄先生：在还押期间，警方未发现针对被告的进一步证据。
梁保，公安局代表：— 根据从罗英 (Loo-wing) 及上海卫戍司令处收到的官方信函（已出示）中的情报，称一名叫高景龙 (Kau Ching Laung) 的人是共产党员，本月5日，此人向我们自首，并牵连被告及另外两人为共产党成员。在上次听审时，被告在公开法庭受讯问时承认，他已加入在华界管辖下的鲁东车（东部上海分部）劳工工会。我请求法庭将被告移交给公安局审判。
被告：— 我不是共产党员。高景龙此人因与我结怨而进行虚假诬陷。
黄先生：— 本案还押是为了让公安局提供进一步证据和一份公函，但最近，除了已出示的公函外，公安局无法提供确凿证据。此外，被告是在租界内被捕的，属于本庭管辖范围，因此我反对将被告移交给公安局审判。
裁决：— 允许将被告移交给公安局审判。

1/2
代理首席法官 Kueh。

Charge Application is hereby made to the S.S.D.Court by the P.S.Bureau for the handing over of the above named person, arrested at 9-05am. the 7/6/34, at 1 Chining Rd. under the authority of a search warrant No.2760, who is wanted by them on a charge of being a Communist.
P.S.S.Inspt.Daung Pau & Tsang Siu (on.

SECOND BRANCH JIANGSU HIGH COURT (..ll.)

Proceedings Mr.Y...an, appeared for the S.H.Council.

Mr.Tang:-At 7-30am.the 7/6/34,the representative of the P.S.Bureau asked the assistance of the Settlement Police to arrest the accused and two others,who were working at the Dah Yeong Rubber Shoe Factory on Chinin Rd. They proceeded to this place,but could only arrest the accused,the other two men being absent. The representative of the P.S.Bureau states that on the 4/6/34,they went to arrest one named Kau Ching Saung there,but he was also absent,but on the 5/6/34,this man surrendered himself to the P.S.Bureau,and there he implicated this accused and the other two as being Communists,so a warrant (Stn.No. ,Court No.662,handed by Mr.Tang to and kept by the Judge)was applied for,and the accused was arrested. He traces of the other two named Lau Kwei Ling and Ting Hec Kueng can be found at present. The police asked that the case be remanded for further evidence and for a despatch to be produced before the accused is handed over to the P.S.Bureau. There was no incriminating evidence found on the accused or at his home.

C.L.C.190:-Corroborated and added,Kau Ching Saung identified this accused as being a member of the Communist Party.

Rep of the P.S.B.Deng Pau:-On the 4/6/34,we received information that one named Kau Ching Saung was a Communist,so went to effect his arrest,but found that he was absent. On the 5/6/34,this man surrendered himself to us,and implicated this accused and the other two already named as being members of the Communist Party,so a warrant was applied for and this accused was arrested,at Chinin Rd. 诉讼程序 Y...an 先生，代表上海工部局出庭。

唐先生：- 1934年6月7日上午7:30，公安局代表请求租界警方协助逮捕被告及另外两人，他们当时在济宁路的大荣 (Dah Yeong) 橡胶鞋厂工作。警方前往该处，但仅能逮捕被告，另外两人不在场。公安局代表称，1934年6月4日，他们前往逮捕一名叫高景松 (Kau Ching Saung) 的人，但他也不在场，但在1934年6月5日，此人向公安局自首，并在那里牵连被告及另外两人为共产党员，因此申请了逮捕令（站点编号 ，法院编号662，由唐先生递交并由法官保存），并逮捕了被告。目前可以找到另外两名名叫刘桂玲 (Lau Kwei Ling) 和丁赫光 (Ting Hec Kueng) 的人的踪迹。警方要求将案件还押以获取进一步证据，并在将被告移交给公安局之前出示一份公函。在被告身上或其家中未发现任何定罪证据。

    证人高景松 (Kan Ching Saung)：- 我是大荣 (Dah Yoon) 橡胶鞋厂的共产党成员。我担任秘书，被告及其他人担任经理。我们没有在工厂外宣传党派，也没有从共产党那里收到任何资金。我们是工厂里仅有的四名共产党员。我目前仍被拘留在公安局。
    被告：- 我不是共产党员，对党派一无所知。这位证人曾邀请我加入工厂里的工人公会，但他从未向我提及任何关于共产党的事情。我从未打算成为共产党员。

裁决    还押至1934年6月18日上午受审。

REPORT
Date June 7, 1934.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. B. REGISTRY. No. D 5925 Date 7 / 6 / 34）

Subject (in full) Execution of Shanghai Special District Court Warrant No.2760.

Made by F.S. Makaroff Forwarded by J.Blu A.

In accordance with the instructions contained in Warrant
No.2760 issued by the Shanghai Special District Court at the
request of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau for the arrest of
three persons named Zau Kwei Ling(曹桂林), Ting Eu Khaung
(丁厚康) and Hauh Kyi(霍機) working at the Dah Yoong(大用)
Rubber Factory, No.1 Chining Road, members of the Special Branch,
accompanied by detectives from Yulin Road Station and represen-
tatives of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau, visited the above
address at 8 a.m. June 7, 1934.
From enquiries made at the factory, it was ascertained that
the first two named Zau Kwei Ling and Ting Eu Khaung had failed
to report for work since 6.6.34. The third named person was
arrested while at work in the factory. He was identified by
Kau Kyung Sung(高敬生或高金生), a converted communist who was
arrested by the Public Safety Bureau in Chinese controlled
territory on 5.6.34.
Hauh Kyi, on being questioned as to the whereabouts of the
other two wanted persons, stated that he did not know their
addresses. The management of the factory was also unable to
furnish the police with any information regarding the two
absconded persons.
A search of the room occupied by Hauh Kyi(霍機) at No.21
Yoh Hwa Faung(月華坊), Ward Road, failed to reveal anything
of an incriminating nature.
The representatives of the Bureau of Public Safety upon
being asked if they desired a watch kept at the factory for the
other two persons stated that they did not want any further action
to be taken at present.
The following detectives comprised the raiding party :-

日期：1934年6月7日。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 档案号 B. 登记处。编号 D 5925 日期 34/6/7）

事由（全称）执行上海特区地方法院第2760号逮捕令。

由 F.S. Makaroff 撰写 经 J.Blu A. 转发

根据上海公安局请求、由上海特区地方法院签发的第2760号逮捕令中所载指令，该逮捕令旨在逮捕在济宁路1号大用橡胶厂工作的三名人员，即曹桂林 (Zau Kwei Ling)、丁厚康 (Ting Eu Khaung) 和霍機 (Hauh Kyi)。特务科成员会同榆林路捕房的侦探以及上海公安局代表，于1934年6月7日上午8时前往上述地址。

经在工厂查询，查明前两名被通缉人曹桂林和丁厚康自1934年6月6日起未上班。第三名被通缉人霍機在工厂工作时被捕。其身份由一名已转变的共产党员高敬生或高金生 (Kau Kyung Sung) 指认，高氏于1934年6月5日在华界被公安局逮捕。

霍機在被问及另外两名通缉犯的下落时，称不知其住址。工厂管理层也无法向警方提供关于这两名潜逃人员的任何信息。

对霍機 (霍機) 位于华德路月華坊 (Yoh Hwa Faung) 21号的住所进行的搜查，未发现任何具有罪证性质的物品。

当被问及是否希望在该工厂对另外两人进行监视时，公安局代表表示目前不希望采取进一步行动。

参与此次突击行动的侦探如下：
